GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On return to scale, rdr reported her mount made slight contact with the front gates, before beginning awkwardly and losing ground. Upon review of the films, the Stewards established that, whilst the gelding had made contact with the front gates prior to the start being affected, its allotted barrier was then slightly delayed in opening. However, bearing in mind the provisions of AR204(1) in relation to gelding's 4th placing, no consideration was given to whether it had been denied a fair start, or if it should be declared a non-starter.
